# Cue 0.1.1 — Updates / App 內更新
## English
Cue can now tell you when a new version is available and install it without a manual app replacement.
- **Check for Updates…** is available in the menu bar menu and **Command+, → Updates**. - Automatic checks run in the background, normally once a day, and can be switched off in Settings. Manual checks remain available. - Scheduled updates show a menu bar indicator and an update entry without stealing keyboard focus. Downloading and installation require your choice; use **Install and Relaunch** when the download is ready. - Update archives and the update feed are verified with Cue's pinned Ed25519 public key through Sparkle 2.10.0. There is no usage analytics or system-profile upload. - Settings now show the installed version. Existing launcher preferences are preserved. - The GitHub repository and release downloads are now public. Release notes are provided in English and Traditional Chinese from this release onward.
Validated with optimized core tests, settings persistence checks, and an isolated updater-enabled app: background reminders, opt-out across relaunch, rejected altered archives and feeds, successful installation/relaunch, and preserved preferences. This fixture tests the new updater; it does not add updating support to the original 0.1.0 app.
### Install or upgrade
[Download Cue 0.1.1](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.1.1/Cue-0.1.1-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.1.1/SHA256SUMS.txt)
**If you have 0.1.0, install this version manually once**: quit Cue, open the DMG, drag Cue into Applications and replace the old copy, then reopen Cue. Version 0.1.0 does not contain an updater. Future versions can be installed from within Cue. Keep the app in a writable installed location; an app running directly from the DMG cannot update itself. A system authorization prompt may appear if installation needs additional permissions.
This universal build targets macOS 14+ and includes Apple silicon and Intel code. Runtime testing is on Apple silicon with macOS 26.6.2; Intel and other macOS versions remain unverified. Cue is still ad hoc-signed and not Apple-notarized: Sparkle update signatures do not replace Developer ID signing or Apple's first-launch checks. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.1.1/docs/installation.md).
## 正體中文
Cue 現在可以提醒新版本，並在 App 內完成更新，不必每次手動取代 App。
- 選單列選單與 **Command+, → Updates** 都可使用 **Check for Updates…**。 - 自動檢查在背景執行，通常每天一次，可在設定中關閉；關閉後仍可手動檢查。 - 排程發現新版時，只顯示選單列提示與更新項目，不會搶走鍵盤焦點。下載與安裝都由你決定；下載完成後按 **Install and Relaunch** 即可安裝並重新啟動。 - 使用 Sparkle 2.10.0 與 Cue 內建的 Ed25519 公開金鑰，驗證更新檔及更新資訊。沒有使用行為分析或系統資訊上傳。 - 設定頁新增目前安裝版本；原有啟動器設定會保留。 - GitHub 儲存庫與下載已公開。從這版開始，版本說明同時提供英文與正體中文。
已通過最佳化建置的核心測試與設定保存檢查，並以包含更新器的隔離測試 App 驗證背景提醒、重啟後保留關閉自動檢查、拒絕遭修改的更新檔與更新資訊、成功安裝並重啟，以及保留原有偏好。這項測試驗證新的更新器，並不代表原本的 0.1.0 已具備更新能力。
### 安裝或升級
[下載 Cue 0.1.1](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.1.1/Cue-0.1.1-universal.dmg) · [檢查碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.1.1/SHA256SUMS.txt)
**0.1.0 使用者需要先手動安裝本版一次**：退出 Cue、開啟 DMG、把 Cue 拖進「應用程式」並取代舊版本，再重新開啟。0.1.0 尚未包含更新器；之後的版本即可從 Cue 內更新。請從已安裝且可寫入的位置執行 App；直接在 DMG 裡執行無法自我更新。安裝若需要額外權限，macOS 可能要求授權。
通用版包含 Apple silicon 與 Intel 程式碼，最低建置目標為 macOS 14。目前僅在 Apple silicon、macOS 26.6.2 實際執行測試；Intel 與其他 macOS 版本仍待驗證。Cue 仍只有 ad hoc 簽章，尚未經 Apple 公證；Sparkle 更新簽章不會取代 Developer ID 或 Apple 的首次開啟檢查。請參閱[安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.1.1/docs/installation.md)。
